title: Final Answer Part (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for sigma(N, tau) as derived from substituting U(N, tau) into sigma(U, N).

title: Final Answer Part (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the entropy from the free energy F(N, tau) and show it matches the result from part (a).

title: Correct Use of Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the relevant equations for entropy and free energy throughout the solution.

title: Logical Reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate clear reasoning in the steps taken to derive the expressions for entropy and free energy.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as sign errors or incorrect logarithmic identities.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explore alternative methods or checks to validate their results.
